newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks end up on short covering.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks end up on short covering.

text.p: Pakistani stocks finished higher on Sunday on covering of short positions ahead of settlement on Monday, dealers said.
"The sentiment is depressed and though the index is up, major players had opted to remain cautious," dealer Khalid Hussain of National Investment and Finance Services said.
The Karachi Stock Exchange 100-share index rose 9.74 points, or 0.70 percent, to close at 1,392.31. Losers led gainers 117 to 104.
Hub Power Co fell 0.30 to 31.20 rupees but Fauji Fertilizer rose 0.55 to 69.90. -- Ovais Subhani 9221-5685192
